failure_corrections.observed: All 28 parsed rows blank, zero raw ANSI bytes, attachment still running before its expected initial control presentation.
failure_corrections.cause: ConsentGate made its listener nonblocking but did not restore blocking mode on accepted client streams. Darwin accept inherits O_NONBLOCK. A request reader can consequently exit on WouldBlock between initial, fragmented or successive frames. The retained shutdown clones keep the abandoned stream open, which can leave pre-render startup waiting for a response rather than receiving EOF.
failure_corrections.evidence_limit: The missing blocking-mode normalization is a concrete source defect; the exact abandoned frame in this captured run was not logged. Attribution of the blank pre-render wait to that frame is [INFERENCE] from the platform behavior, source and zero-output evidence. The existing daemon framing boundary already explicitly clears inherited O_NONBLOCK for the same reason.
failure_corrections.correction: Normalize accepted proxy streams to blocking mode before framing, retain the existing bounded read/write deadlines, and shut down both owned ends when a framing worker terminates so retained clones cannot hide connection failure.
failure_corrections.preserved_ordering: The real daemon consent response is still withheld only after the daemon processes it. The TUI remains free to draw and enqueue consumed-prefix Keep followed by paste on its original connection; the proxy does not fabricate responses or authority.
